hasDefinedTerm.name: MLS
hasDefinedTerm.description: Multiple listing service. The shared database brokers use to list and search properties in a market.

hasDefinedTerm.name: IDX
hasDefinedTerm.description: Internet data exchange. The framework letting brokers publish MLS listings on their own websites.

hasDefinedTerm.name: comps
hasDefinedTerm.description: Recently sold similar properties used to estimate what a home is worth.

hasDefinedTerm.name: CMA
hasDefinedTerm.description: Comparative market analysis. An agent's valuation estimate built from comparable sales.

hasDefinedTerm.name: appraisal
hasDefinedTerm.description: A licensed valuation of a property, usually required by a lender.

hasDefinedTerm.name: days on market
hasDefinedTerm.description: How long a listing has been active before going under contract.

hasDefinedTerm.name: absorption rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: How quickly available inventory sells in a market, usually expressed in months of supply.

hasDefinedTerm.name: under contract
hasDefinedTerm.description: An accepted offer with conditions still outstanding, so the sale is not yet complete.

hasDefinedTerm.name: contingency
hasDefinedTerm.description: A condition that must be met before a sale closes, such as financing or inspection.

hasDefinedTerm.name: escrow
hasDefinedTerm.description: Funds or documents held by a neutral third party until closing conditions are met.

hasDefinedTerm.name: closing costs
hasDefinedTerm.description: Fees paid at completion, covering lending, title, and transfer charges.

hasDefinedTerm.name: title insurance
hasDefinedTerm.description: Coverage protecting against defects in a property's ownership history.

hasDefinedTerm.name: lien
hasDefinedTerm.description: A legal claim against a property securing a debt.

hasDefinedTerm.name: deed
hasDefinedTerm.description: The instrument transferring ownership of real property.

hasDefinedTerm.name: earnest money
hasDefinedTerm.description: A deposit showing a buyer's good faith, credited at closing.

hasDefinedTerm.name: pre-approval
hasDefinedTerm.description: A lender's conditional commitment to a loan amount, based on verified financials.

hasDefinedTerm.name: PMI
hasDefinedTerm.description: Private mortgage insurance. Required by lenders when a down payment falls below a threshold.

hasDefinedTerm.name: HOA
hasDefinedTerm.description: Homeowners association. The body governing shared areas and rules in a community, funded by member dues.

hasDefinedTerm.name: zoning
hasDefinedTerm.description: Local rules dictating how a parcel of land may be used and what may be built on it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: variance
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission to depart from zoning rules for a specific property.

hasDefinedTerm.name: easement
hasDefinedTerm.description: A right for someone else to use part of a property for a defined purpose.

hasDefinedTerm.name: setback
hasDefinedTerm.description: The minimum required distance between a structure and a property line.

hasDefinedTerm.name: cap rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: Net operating income divided by property value. A yield measure for income property.

hasDefinedTerm.name: NOI
hasDefinedTerm.description: Net operating income. Rental income less operating expenses, before debt service and taxes.

hasDefinedTerm.name: cash on cash return
hasDefinedTerm.description: Annual pre-tax cash flow divided by the cash actually invested.

hasDefinedTerm.name: DSCR
hasDefinedTerm.description: Debt service coverage ratio. Net operating income divided by debt payments.

hasDefinedTerm.name: 1031 exchange
hasDefinedTerm.description: A US provision deferring capital gains tax when sale proceeds are reinvested in like-kind property.

hasDefinedTerm.name: triple net lease
hasDefinedTerm.description: A commercial lease where the tenant pays taxes, insurance, and maintenance on top of rent.

hasDefinedTerm.name: gross lease
hasDefinedTerm.description: A lease where the landlord covers operating expenses out of the rent.

hasDefinedTerm.name: tenant improvement
hasDefinedTerm.description: Work done to fit a commercial space to a tenant's needs, often funded by an allowance.

hasDefinedTerm.name: vacancy rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of rentable space sitting empty.

hasDefinedTerm.name: class A
hasDefinedTerm.description: The top tier of commercial property quality, by age, location, and finish.

hasDefinedTerm.name: cap ex
hasDefinedTerm.description: Spending on improvements that extend a property's life or value, as distinct from routine repairs.

hasDefinedTerm.name: property management
hasDefinedTerm.description: Day-to-day operation of a property on the owner's behalf.

hasDefinedTerm.name: iBuyer
hasDefinedTerm.description: A company making algorithmic instant cash offers on homes.

hasDefinedTerm.name: pocket listing
hasDefinedTerm.description: A property marketed privately rather than through the MLS.

hasDefinedTerm.name: dual agency
hasDefinedTerm.description: One agent or brokerage representing both sides of a transaction. Restricted or barred in some jurisdictions.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Google Business Profile
hasDefinedTerm.description: The listing controlling how a business appears in maps and local results.

hasDefinedTerm.name: geo page
hasDefinedTerm.description: A location-targeted landing page. Valuable when genuinely local, thin when templated across towns.

hasDefinedTerm.name: farming
hasDefinedTerm.description: Concentrating marketing on one geographic area to build recognition over time.
